integrity.proof_type: self-contained analytical proof using standard Dirichlet-beta and central-limit identities

scientific_limitations: Exact-degree homogeneous holomorphic polynomials on complex spheres in dimensions at least three. The odd-degree branch transition is proved to occur at least once, not to occur uniquely. No extension to arbitrary bandlimited analytic functions or global Bergman Toeplitz operators is established.
title: Balanced extremizers and a parity-dependent spectral-gap transition for holomorphic product caps
